Name: SpaceCore
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]SpaceCore[/b] is a framework mod used by some of my other mods. It also adds a bunch of features for content pack authors.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]For players:[/b] just install the mod normally, and it'll work for the mods that need it.
[*][b]For mod authors:[/b] SpaceCore's functionality is documented on the [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/framework/SpaceCore/docs]readme on github[/url].
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer (make sure all players have the mod installed!).

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/framework/SpaceCore/docs]Documentation[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
